mapper.insert: INSERT INTO foster_return (adopt_id, user_id, pet_id, reason, description, photo, status, apply_time) VALUES (#{adoptId}, #{userId}, #{petId}, #{reason}, #{description}, #{photo}, 1, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, p.pet_name FROM foster_return f LEFT JOIN pet p ON f.pet_id = p.pet_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.apply_time DESC
SELECT * FROM foster_return WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY apply_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM foster_return WHERE adopt_id = #{adoptId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY apply_time DESC LIMIT 1
